audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-5 read Skill/Vladimir/Vladimir/Skill/Skill/Vladimir while every why underneath says Aurora wins that stage. Packet chart is Aurora x6 then Vladimir.
audit.why: The chart and the prose gave opposite answers on six of seven rows. The prose and the packet agree, so the chart is the wrong half.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 flipped to Aurora in matched full/content pairs, ratings dropped to 4/10; row 6 stays Vladimir.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns and no ranges; 'her range' was asserted six times without ever being quantified.
audit.why: Twofold Hex is 900 range on 9s against Transfusion's 600 on 9s; Across the Veil 22s; Between Worlds 140/120/100; Sanguine Pool 28s. That is the whole reason you cannot answer her chip.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[0], phases[1], phases[3], phases[4], spikes[0], spikes[1], early and breakdown.cooldowns, exactly as the mirror audit asked.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Weeping Wound' is not an Aurora ability — her R is Between Worlds — and it was described as rooting. Riot's text is a shockwave that damages and slows, then a field that slows and lets her teleport across. No root anywhere. Across the Veil's invisibility on landing and Spirit Abjuration's healing were both absent.
audit.why: A player told to 'Pool the root' will hold a 28s cooldown for a root that does not exist and then die inside the field. Across the Veil going invisible is what actually breaks Transfusion's target lock, and Spirit Abjuration is why she wins extended chip.
audit.corrected: Between Worlds named and described as slow-and-zone; invisibility and the healing passive stated; anti-heal made the itemization trigger.

edits.before: Q-drain on cooldown — you trade HP like a loan shark. Identify how Aurora contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Aurora out-ranges you at 1: Twofold Hex is 900 to Transfusion's 600, and her exorcised spirits heal her as she pokes.

edits.before: Pool answers his single biggest button — save it for exactly that. Only take the trade when Aurora's Twofold Hex is down.
edits.after: Her poke and Across the Veil keep her safe. Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 — never spend it answering Twofold Hex chip.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aurora must walk into your range.
edits.after: Across the Veil goes invisible on landing and sidesteps your Transfusion lock; charge Tides behind your own casters.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Twofold Hex's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still hers: Twofold Hex is 9s at rank 1 at 900 range, so her chip outpaces your sustain. Buy anti-heal — her passive heals her.

edits.before: Hemoplague + empowered Q turns mid-game fights into resets. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Aurora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Between Worlds slows and zones rather than roots, and it is 140s at rank 1. Refuse the fight inside the field, take it outside.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Twofold Hex's cooldown.
edits.after: Her first AP item still out-damages your healing; farm to Riftmaker before you force anything.

edits.before: Level 6 is hers: Weeping Wound roots you for a full combo.
edits.after: Level 6 is hers: Between Worlds slows and zones your exit.

edits.before: Aurora's Twofold Hex plus Across the Veil dash lets her poke and blink onto you; her spirit-exorcism passive procs bonus magic damage every trade and her W dash sidesteps your Transfusion lock.
edits.after: Aurora's Twofold Hex plus Across the Veil lets her poke and then vanish; Spirit Abjuration heals her through every trade, and the 22s W turns invisible on landing, which drops your Transfusion lock.

edits.before: The Weeping Wound ult zones and roots you inside its zone; Pool the root or you eat her full combo, and even then her range keeps her ahead.
edits.after: Between Worlds is 140s at rank 1: a shockwave slow, then a field she teleports across. Fight outside it — inside the field her range decides everything.

edits.before: She holds the lead through 3-6 — the W dash dodges your Q lock and her ult roots you for a full combo. Respect her range, Pool the root, and stall to items.
edits.after: She holds the lead through 3-6 — Across the Veil dodges your Q lock and Between Worlds slows you inside its field. Respect her range and stall to your items.

edits.before: Aurora out-pokes you levels 1-2 with Twofold Hex and her exorcism passive proccing extra magic damage; her range means you take chip you can't return, so farm carefully.
edits.after: Aurora out-pokes you levels 1-2 with 900-range Twofold Hex while Spirit Abjuration heals her off every proc; you cannot return that chip, so farm carefully and buy anti-heal early.

edits.before: Pool her R root instead of eating the full combo
edits.after: Pool her Between Worlds shockwave, not her Q chip

edits.before: Zone you with Weeping Wound and combo the root
edits.after: Zone you with Between Worlds and combo the slow

edits.before: - Aurora Twofold Hex: matchup-defining — Her escape. Poke when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twofold Hex: 9s at rank 1, 900 range — the recast drags the curse back, so keep moving. - Across the Veil: 22s blink into invisibility. - Between Worlds: 140s. - Sanguine Pool: 28s, never on chip. - Hemoplague: 120s.

notes: 'Weeping Wound' is fabricated and described a root Aurora does not have; it appeared in whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[2], all corrected. Twofold Hex is still called 'Twofold Hex (Blink)' in breakdown.trading, dosFull[2].d, report[3] and report[5] — the blink is Across the Veil (W), not the Q, so those four strings need the parenthetical dropped.
